commit.message: feat(workflow): separate step dataflow from config
feat(workflow): add compatibility and step identity laws

fix(workflow): read dependencies only from step references

dependencies took the second element of every reference, so a step id
sitting in any other reference kind became an edge. Step :a wiring
[:literal :a :value] reported :workflow/cyclic-dataflow alongside the
:workflow/unsupported-reference that is the actual fault, pointing at a
cycle that was never declared.

Only [:step producer output] contributes an edge now. The vector? guard
also stops a non-sequential reference from throwing out of dependencies
before wire can report it — :step/in {:source :a} raised "Don't know how
to create ISeq from: Keyword" rather than producing a finding.
